about: C9 critic: a player who pokes at the opening: mashes the mouse as BEGIN lands, moves the mouse, presses W / number keys / Q / F / M, ESC once (does a pause come, is the run held?), then ESC again; and BEGIN again from the title with the run skipped at once: how fast is control back, what is up.

steps.eval: 'after keys: active ' + G.stills.active + ' panel ' + (G.stills.run && G.stills.run.panel) + ' muted? ' + (G.audio && G.audio.muted)

'ESC once: active ' + G.stills.active + ' state ' + G.state + ' panel ' + (G.stills.run && G.stills.run.panel) + ' hint ' + (document.querySelector('#stills') && document.querySelector('#stills').innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,120))
'2.5 s later: active ' + G.stills.active + ' panel ' + (G.stills.run && G.stills.run.panel)
